description: TransFlow is a transient gas-pipeline flow library. The public repository describes CMake builds, example executables, generated documentation and a container-based development environment. The provider is FSund (repository owner). Coverage: The model is configured for individual gas-pipeline problems. The README does not establish geographic cases, input-date coverage or numerical resolution. Access: The provider publishes a metadata page describing the resource and its access route. Resource files were not downloaded or executed. Licence and cost: The repository identifies MIT. Numerical libraries and toolchains have separate licences. Limitations: The documented environment includes several numerical dependencies and old version examples. Independent reuse and current maintenance were not established. For simulation it offers an experimental pipeline-transient implementation. Related resources: For comparison, model-pandapipes provides pipe-network modelling. This is a thematic link, not evidence of use in this study.
